description: Telegram bot for community prediction markets. Admin adds bot → community creates + bets on markets inside Telegram. Stellar settlement behind the scenes.
coreLoop: admin adds bot → create market → members join → Stellar settles → rewards auto-distributed
features: Telegram bot: add to group, create markets in chat with /create
Market types: price above/below, candle direction, sports outcomes, community milestones
Non-crypto UX: internal balance, no wallets/seed phrases shown to users
Quick templates: 5m/15m/1h timers, Yes/No, Over/Under options
Auto settlement via Stellar (XLM/USDC, hidden from users)
Telegram mini app for payment/history details
contentAngles: Your community already predicts — now bet on it inside Telegram
No app download, no seed phrase, no DeFi knowledge needed
Admin adds one bot, community runs its own markets
Telegram-native prediction layer, Stellar settlement invisible

roadmap.P1: May-Jul 2026 — Bot MVP: 20-50 communities, 300-1,000 markets, 1,000-3,000 participants
roadmap.P3: Nov 2026-Jan 2027 — Default bot: 500-1,000 communities, 50,000-100,000 participants, $250K+ volume
